claim: Let \(k\) be algebraically closed of characteristic \(2\), and let \(d\ge3\). For the standard rational normal curve \(C_d=\{[s^d:s^{d-1}t:\cdots:t^d]\}\subset\mathbb P^d\), the reduced closure \(T_d\) of its embedded tangent lines is the smooth rational normal scroll \(S(a,b)\), where \(a=\lfloor d/2\rfloor\) and \(b=\lfloor(d-1)/2\rfloor\); thus \(\deg T_d=d-1\). The tangent-incidence parametrization has purely inseparable generic degree \(2\) onto \(T_d\).
